name: Digestive
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat flour (Maida) (35.2%), Refined Palm Oil, Wheat flour (Atta) (18.4%), Sugar, Wheat Bran (4.3%), Liquid glucose, Raising agents [INS 500(ii), INS 503), INS 450(1), Maltodextrin, Milk solids, iodized Salt, Emulsifiers (Lecithin Energy(from Soyabean), Diacetyltartaric and fatty Protein ( acid esters of glycerol (from sunflower oil & palm oil), Mono - & di-glycerides of fatty acids (from palm oil)], Malt Extract (0.2%), Nature identical flavouring substances, Wheat fibre (0.03%), Flour treatment agent (INS 223) and Artificial flavouring (Vanilla).
